verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a built-in research agent that chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper discovery. It also offers Deep Search for literature reviews and conversational Threads, so users can hand research tasks to an in-product AI. The evidence is short marketing copy limited to academic research tasks, so how far a user can delegate is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what tasks the agent can run autonomously and how multi-step delegation works, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Consensus has evolved from a search tool into a research agent. Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.
Introducing: Consensus Deep Search 🔬 Literature Reviews in Minutes.
Threads reimagines how you interact with peer-reviewed research by turning isolated searches into flowing conversations.
